models.model_label: Main repeated-measures mixed ANCOVA of linked and nonlinked fixation proportions
models.sample_description: Voluntary experiment with 60 employees recruited from several accounting and multinational corporations. Participants evaluated two SBU managers using a balanced scorecard and were assigned to benchmark, narrative, or strategy-map presentation conditions; the repeated measure is linked versus nonlinked fixation proportion. Experiment dates are not reported.
models.method_reported: 2 × 3 repeated measure mixed analysis of covariance (ANCOVA)
models.method_details: The paper reports a 2 × 3 repeated-measures mixed ANCOVA. The between-subject factor is SBU strategy-information presentation format (benchmark, narrative, strategy map); the within-subject factor is favored measure category (linked or nonlinked). Gender and length of work experience are covariates. Table 6 reports omnibus F tests by source, not individual coefficient estimates. The paper does not name a separate underlying coefficient estimator or parameterization.

dependent_variable.name: Proportion of time spent on strategically linked and nonlinked performance measures
dependent_variable.definition: For each participant, the repeated outcome is the proportion of fixation time spent on the linked or nonlinked BSC items. The authors identify items by strategic linkage, tag fixation time to the items, sum time for linked and nonlinked items, and calculate their proportions. A qualifying fixation is at least 333.33 milliseconds within an area of interest of maximum radius 50 pixels. Table 3 reports six participants with zero qualifying fixation time for both categories and retains them.

evidence.quote: We summed the time the participants spent on all the strategically linked and nonlinked items
The dependent variable was the proportion of time spent on the strategically linked and nonlinked
fixation defined as spending at least 333.33 milliseconds (0.3333 seconds)
The sum of ratio of time spent on linked and nonlinked measures does not add up to 1

missing_fields.independent_variables.iv_003.definition: Working experience is identified as a covariate and the participant section states that average work experience was five years. review_notes: Selected the single full-sample Table 6 ANCOVA as the paper’s eligible baseline fit for H2/H3, testing linked versus nonlinked attention and presentation format. Table 5’s H1 mean-split chi-square contingency tests and Table 7’s t tests are nonregression analyses and are not separate model records.

The fitted outcome is reported as linked/nonlinked fixation proportions, but the denominator is not fully specified; six participants with no qualifying fixation have zero on both categories and remain in the source sample.

Gender coding is unspecified. The participant section reports average work experience of five years, while Table 3 reports Experience mean 3.53; the source does not reconcile the values or specify the exact measurement/coding period.
